subject: Unit economics - post-call recap & pricing qualification
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintechx.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / Demo - post-call recap & next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning, Alex - great to meet you and learn more about FintechX's planned personal finance product. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

- Scope: user-facing summaries + personalized insights triggered by transactions; we estimated ~50M tokens/month at pilot (avg prompt+completion ~200 tokens) and potentially 300-400M tokens/mo at scale.
- Key requirements: 99th pct latency ~400ms, PII controls (VPC option), SOC2 evidence for procurement.
- Next steps: I promised a short unit-economics note and a pricing qualification so your finance/procurement can align.

Can you confirm the expected pilot ARR/Budget range for inference and the initial target $/1M tokens range you're comfortable with? Also please share approximate MAU and projected CAC targets so we can map $/feature.

I've attached a short unit-econ template that helps match $/1M tokens -> $/feature and CAC payback assumptions. Suggest we sync with procurement next week if numbers align.

Thanks - Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_unit_econ_template.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / Demo - post-call recap & next steps

Marissa - thanks for the recap and the template. Confirming the pilot assumptions to help you calibrate pricing: 

- Pilot: 50k MAU, expected avg 2 calls/day per active (100k calls/day). We estimated your token avg ~200 so ~20M tokens/mo for pilot (we had a lower internal estimate than on the call).
- Budget: pilot inference budget is in the $8k–$12k/month range. If the pilot shows value, scale target is 300–400k MAU over 12 months.
- CAC/payback: our LTV/CAC target is 12–18 months; CAC for this product is currently $40–$60 per acquired user.

Quick ask: can you put together a 1-page mapping of $/1M tokens -> $/feature (per MAU) and show how different unit-costs affect CAC payback and gross margin? Procurement will want a clear range.

— Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of Product, FintechX
alex.j@fintechx.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintechx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / Demo - unit economics mapping (pilot -> scale)

Alex - thanks, that clarity helps a lot. I've drafted a short one-pager below and attached the detailed template. High-level map: 

1) $/1M tokens -> list price examples (hosted API, 8-bit quantized dedicated, private)
   - $/1M tokens = $120 (hosted high-throughput) 
   - $/1M tokens = $70 (dedicated, quantized profiles) 
   - $/1M tokens = $40 (private/on-prem, amortized infra)

2) Translate to $/MAU/feature (assumptions: 2 calls/day, 200 tokens per call => 400 tokens/user/day => ~12M tokens/Month per 100k MAU)
   - Pilot (50k MAU, 20M tokens/mo) => at $120/1M = $2,400/mo; at $70 = $1,400/mo; at $40 = $800/mo

3) Impact on CAC payback & gross margin (very approximate) 
   - Assume feature revenue per MAU = $2/month (pilot pricing model). 
   - For 50k MAU, revenue = $100k/mo. If inference cost = $2,400/mo (hosted), inference % of gross = 2.4% (negligible). If private cost = $800/mo, even lower. 
   - If we model per-feature incremental revenue and include other infra/Ops, we'll prepare a table in the template showing payback windows for CAC = $40–$60.

4) Ask for procurement: confirm whether procurement needs SOC2 artifacts up-front (we can provide) and whether an initial 3-month commitment is preferred vs month-to-month.

I’m happy to walk through the attached spreadsheet with your finance/procurement team. Would Thursday 11/27 at 10am PT work for a short 30min alignment?

Thanks - Marissa

Attachment: redwood_unit_econ_template.xlsx

From: Procurement <procurement@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / Demo - SOW & procurement questions

Marissa / Ben - procurement here. A couple quick questions before scheduling: 

1) Can you send SOC2 Type II report and a short summary of data residency / VPC options?
2) For the pricing bands you listed, do you provide committed discounts at 12-month reserved capacity? What are minimum commit thresholds?
3) Please include a short draft SOW for pilot (deliverables, success criteria, data access model).

We'd like answers by EOD Monday so we can route internally.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
procurement@fintechx.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@fintechx.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.j@fintechx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / Demo - SOW & procurement questions

Hi procurement - attaching a short SOW draft and the SOC2 summary + unit-econ workbook. Quick answers inline:

1) SOC2: attached "SOC2_summary_redwood.pdf" (short summary) and we can share the full report under an NDA / secure portal. Data residency: We support regionally isolated Private deployments; Hosted is available in us-west and eu-west regions.
2) Committed discounts: yes - 12-month reserved capacity offers tiered discounts. Typical thresholds: 1) Pilot tier: no commit (month-to-month) 2) Reserved Bronze: >= $10k/month commit -> ~15% off hosted list 3) Reserved Silver: >= $50k/month -> ~30% off; 4) Enterprise/private negotiations for >$200k/month. We'll include exact numbers in a follow-up SOW.
3) SOW draft attached (pilot scope, deliverables, success criteria).

Attached: SOW_draft_fintechx_v1.pdf; redwood_unit_econ_template.xlsx; SOC2_summary_redwood.pdf

I'll hold the 11/27 10am PT slot tentatively - if that still works for you Alex, confirm and I'll send calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa
